mapper.sql: SELECT bom_id, bom_no, bom_name, product_id, product_code, product_name, base_qty, base_unit, bom_status, dept_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM pdm_design_bom_item i WHERE i.bom_id = bom_id) AS item_count, (SELECT v.version_no FROM pdm_doc_version v WHERE v.biz_type = '3' AND v.biz_id = bom_id AND v.effective_flag = '1' ORDER BY v.version_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS current_version_no, (SELECT r.ebom_version FROM pdm_mbom_release r WHERE r.product_id = pdm_design_bom.product_id AND r.release_status = '0' ORDER BY r.release_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS released_version_no FROM pdm_design_bom
mapper.select: SELECT item_id, bom_id, parent_id, item_level, material_id, material_code, material_name, spec_model, unit, usage_qty, loss_rate, order_num, remark FROM pdm_design_bom_item WHERE bom_id = #{bomId} ORDER BY order_num ASC, item_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pdm_design_bom (bom_no, bom_name, product_id, product_code, product_name, base_qty, base_unit, bom_status, dept_id, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{bomNo}, #{bomName}, #{productId}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{baseQty}, #{baseUnit}, #{bomStatus}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})

INSERT INTO pdm_design_bom_item (bom_id, parent_id, item_level, material_id, material_code, material_name, spec_model, unit, usage_qty, loss_rate, order_num, remark) VALUES (#{bomId}, #{parentId}, #{itemLevel}, #{materialId}, #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{specModel}, #{unit}, #{usageQty}, #{lossRate}, #{orderNum}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE pdm_design_bom_item SET parent_id = #{parentId}, item_level = #{itemLevel} WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.delete: UPDATE pdm_design_bom SET del_flag = '2' WHERE bom_id IN #{bomId}
